statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9, I48.0)
CPT 93226 is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The service was ordered to correlate symptoms with underlying rhythm disturbances
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
